THE WEDSPARKS GUIDE

How to Compare Wedding Supplier Quotes

Two similar prices can describe very different services. Make a like-for-like comparison before choosing.

Start your wedding planExplore suppliers

By WedSparks · Wedding planning guide

01

Write down the service you need

Give each supplier the same date, location, guest count and outline. If something is undecided, say so rather than letting different assumptions shape the quotes.

02

Compare the inclusions

Check service hours, the number of people involved, equipment, travel, delivery, setup and pack-down. Ask what is optional and what would create an extra charge.

03

Check the practical fit

Consider availability, communication, style and how the supplier will work with your venue. Look at real examples of their work and ask the questions that matter to you.

04

Look at the payment schedule

Compare the full amount, deposits, due dates and the terms for changes or cancellations. Request an updated written quote if you change the scope.

05

Keep the final version

Record which version you accepted and store it with the supplier’s details. Update your budget from that agreed amount rather than leaving the original estimate in place.
